messages:
Lena Ortiz: FYI the hourly telemetry for `session_duration` shows a hole 2026-03-22 03:00-03:59 UTC. Dashboard shows full-zeros for shard 47. Might be late consumer or schema tweak upstream.
Devon Park: Confirmed zeros. Latest consumer commit touched event_key normalization. We should avoid full replay until we validate idempotency.
Ibrahim Noor: Can we run a 'slice + diff' flow from the console? Small canary, compute delta, then decide routing/quota.
Priya Shah: Console supports preview but only reports counts. UX ask: surface routing label (reserved vs background), estimated CU cost, and a sample row diff.
Lena Ortiz: Proposal: run a 1-hour canary for shard 47 in preview mode with emit_samples=20 and emit_invalidation_preview=true. If checksum delta < 0.2% -> schedule targeted recompute with quota=background between 04:00-07:00 UTC.
Devon Park: I'll submit internal job. Using POST /recompute with body '{"range":"2026-03-22T03:00:00Z/2026-03-22T04:00:00Z","shards":[47],"preview":true,"emit_samples":20,"quota":"background","emit_invalidation_preview":true}'.
backfill-bot: Job created: preview-1718503210-047 (status: queued)
Ibrahim Noor: Add a temporary routing policy: auto-cancel related promote jobs if preview returns schema diffs (field list mismatch) or checksum delta > 0.5%. That avoids bad promotions.
Priya Shah: Also add UI hint: when preview returns invalidation keys, show downstream services affected and estimated downstream recompute cost. Small modal: promote | schedule | abort.
Devon Park: Preview started, output goes to s3://telemetry-previews/1718503210/preview-47.jsonl.gz
backfill-bot: Job running: preview-1718503210-047 (status: running)
Devon Park: Preview finished. Checksum delta 0.04%. Sample diff: 8 rows adjusted for timestamp normalization. Invalidation preview keys: inv:session_duration:shard:47:20260322T03.
Lena Ortiz: Sounds safe. Please schedule promote with fair-share quota cap=500 CU and cost_cap=1000 so it doesn't spike reserved pools.
Ibrahim Noor: Agreed. Also add a short pre-promote smoke: refresh dashboard widgets for this metric after first 10% of partitions processed to detect regressions early.
Priya Shah: I'll file a tiny console PR to show quota_profile, est CU, and a one-click smoke check toggle for promote flows.
backfill-bot: Promote job queued: promote-1718503625-047 (status: queued)
Devon Park: Curl for promote (internal): ```bash
curl -X POST https://internal-api/recompute \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"range":"2026-03-22T03:00:00Z/2026-03-22T04:00:00Z","shards":[47],"preview":false,"quota":"fair-share","quota_cap":500,"cost_cap":1000,"schedule":"2026-03-22T04:30:00Z","post_promote_smoke":true}'
```
Lena Ortiz: Thanks. Track the job here and paste smoke results. If anything >0.5% delta we abort and open incident.
Ibrahim Noor: Will monitor. If promote runs long, route to background queue with preemption policy.
Priya Shah: PR opened for the modal, pinging reviewers. :rocket:
